summary: Learn Python forecasting, scenario analysis, and validation workflows. Build practical models and decision-ready outputs in 5 days.
lede: Python for business forecasting and scenario analysis gives you a repeatable way to prepare time-series data, build and compare models, and turn changing assumptions into clear scenario outputs. Using pandas, statsmodels, train-test splits, rolling validation, and error metrics such as MAE, RMSE, and MAPE, you can create forecasts with a measurable accuracy profile. You will practice data cleaning, time-series indexing, feature creation, baseline forecasting, exponential smoothing, ARIMA and SARIMA concepts, and scenario table design. The course also covers prediction intervals, exogenous variables, and operational forecasting pipelines so you can explain forecast implications clearly to finance, operations, and executive audiences.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who need to forecast business activity, test assumptions, and explain results using Python-based analysis.
prerequisites: You should have intermediate Python skills, including working with notebooks, variables, functions, and basic data structures. Prior experience with pandas is helpful, but the course revisits the data handling steps needed for forecasting. No coding from scratch expertise is required beyond the ability to run and adapt Python scripts. Participants should bring a laptop with Python access and be ready to work with tabular business datasets; the course is suitable for professionals who want practical forecasting methods, not advanced machine learning engineering.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
